full_text_zh:
[P1] 小羊和老虎
连环画出版社

[P4] 杨永青（1928— ）上海人。擅长版画。早年师从上海著名人物画家谢闲鸥先生。1952年至1987年历任华东青年出版社、中国青年出版社、中国少年儿童出版社美术编辑、编审。共创作儿童图书220余册。曾获全国少年儿童图书评奖美术一等奖、国际安徒生奖提名及中国出版署等机构颁发的多种奖项。

[P5] 小山羊和小老虎
鲁兵/诗 杨永青/画
连环画出版社

[P6] 羊，羊，一只小山羊。
虎，虎，一只小老虎。

小山羊毛儿雪白雪白，
叫起来：咩咩，咩咩；
小老虎尾巴老粗老粗，
叫起来：啊呜，啊呜。

[P7] 前一天，
小山羊起得很早，
唱着歌儿，
到树林里去吃草。

[P8] 这一天，
小老虎也起得很早，
吃饱早饭，
到树林里去打虎跳。

[P9] 一个叫：咩咩，
一个叫：啊呜，
小山羊碰见了小老虎。
一个唱歌儿，
一个打虎跳，
他们捉了迷藏又赛跑。

[P10] 太阳下山了，
小老虎回家了。
“妈妈，妈妈，告诉您，
今天我跟小山羊玩耍了。”

[P12] 听着，听着，
小老虎张大嘴巴；
听着，听着，
小老虎口水流得滴滴答。
“妈妈，妈妈，
干吗不早告诉我？
明天起个早，
我就到树林里去咬死他。”
老虎妈妈，摇一摇尾巴：
“对了，对了，
这才像只老虎啊！
不过，不过，
你得学会说谎话。
先说，先说：
‘咱们是好朋友啊！’
再说，再说：
‘我来找你玩耍啦！’
等他，等他，
一走近来，你就逮住他。”

[P13] 星星出来了，
小山羊回家了，
“妈妈，妈妈，告诉您，
今天我跟小老虎玩耍啦！”
山羊妈妈吃一惊，
呆了半天才说话：
“什么，什么，
你跟小老虎玩耍？
孩子，孩子，
今天你多危险啊！
差点，差点，
你给他当点心啦！
明天，明天，
他再来找你玩耍，
哎呀，哎呀，
一定是来吃你啦！
不怕，不怕，
让妈妈来想一个好办法。”

[P14] 第二天，
小老虎走过山岗，
没有见着小山羊；
走啊，走啊，
小老虎走进树林，
没有等着小山羊。
小老虎找到一间小屋子，
把门儿敲得笃笃笃笃响。

[P15] “咩咩，你是谁呀？
“啊呜，我是小老虎啊！
“咩咩，你干什么来？
“啊呜，我找小山羊来玩耍！”，

[P16] “咩咩，我知道，
你妈妈告诉你什么话。”
“啊呜，妈妈说：
咱们是一对好朋友啊！
“咩咩，我知道，
你想了些什么坏主意。
“啊呜，我想的：
跟你一起唱歌做游戏。”
“咩咩，你说谎话。
你还是趁早滚开吧！
“啊呜，我说真话。
快点把门儿开开吧！
“咩咩，咩咩，
不开，不开，我不开。
“啊呜，啊呜，
你不开门，我就闯进来。”

[P17] 小老虎渴呀真渴，
小老虎饿呀真饿；
小老虎磨呀磨快爪子，
小老虎肚子里咕噜噜响，
恨不得一口吞下小山羊；
嘭嘭，嘭嘭，嘭嘭……
小老虎翘起尾巴撞起门来啦！
叽格，叽格，叽格……
小老虎快把门儿撞开啦！

[P18] 咩嘿嘿，咩嘿嘿，
东边来了五只大山羊；
咩嘿嘿，咩嘿嘿，
西边来了五只大山羊。
一只山羊一对角，
十只山羊十对角，
羊角弯弯像镰刀，
朝着小老虎撞啊挑。

[P21] 咩嘿嘿，咩嘿嘿，
你这个小强盗！
咩嘿嘿，咩嘿嘿，
看你往哪里跑？

一只山羊用脚踩，
两只山羊用嘴咬，
三只山羊用头撞，
四只山羊用角挑，
一挑，一挑，
把小老虎挑得半天高。

小老虎嘴里，
掉了三个牙齿；
小老虎脚上，
伤了四个爪子；
小老虎耳边，
少了一片毛毛；
小老虎头顶，
多了两个包包。

[P22] 小老虎在草地上打滚，
疼得“啊呜啊呜”叫；
小山羊在门缝里瞧着，
乐得“咩咩咩咩”笑。

[P25] 毛毛虫童书馆·第一辑

《香蕉娃娃》

《胖嫂回娘家》
《三十六个字》

《三借芭蕉扇》
《动物园》

《聪明的乌龟》

《雪狮子》
full_text_en:
[P1] Little Sheep and Tiger
Lianhuanhua Publishing House

[P4] Yang Yongqing (1928— ) was from Shanghai and specialized in woodcut prints. He studied under the renowned Shanghai portrait painter Mr. Xie Xianou. From 1952 to 1987, he served as an art editor and chief editor at the East China Youth Publishing House, China Youth Publishing House, and China Children's Publishing House. He created over 220 children's books. He received the First Prize for Art in the National Children's Book Awards, was nominated for the Hans Christian Andersen Award, and won various other awards from institutions including the China Publishing Administration.

[P5] Little Goat and Little Tiger
Lu Bing / Poem  Yang Yongqing / Illustrations
Lianhuanhua Publishing House

[P6] Sheep, sheep, a little mountain sheep.
Tiger, tiger, a little tiger.

The little mountain sheep's wool is white as snow,
It calls out: Baa, baa;
The little tiger's tail is thick and thick,
It calls out: Roar, roar.

[P7] The day before,
the little goat got up very early,
singing a song,
and went to the forest to eat grass.

[P8] This day,
the little tiger also got up very early,
eaten his breakfast,
and went to the forest to do tiger jumps.

[P9] One called: Baa baa,
One called: Roar roar,
The little goat met the little tiger.
One sang a song,
One did tiger jumps,
They played hide-and-seek and raced.

[P10] The sun has set,
and the little tiger is going home.
"Mommy, mommy, I have to tell you,
today I played with the little goat."

[P12] Listening, listening,
the little tiger opens its mouth wide;
listening, listening,
the little tiger's saliva drips.
"Mom, mom,
why didn't you tell me earlier?
Tomorrow, I'll get up early
and go to the forest to bite him to death."
The tiger mom, wagging her tail:
"Right, right,
that's what a tiger should be like!
But, but,
you must learn to tell lies.
First, first:
'We're good friends!'
Then, then:
'I've come to play with you!'
Wait for him, wait for him,
the moment he comes close, you catch him."

[P13] The stars came out,
the little goat came home,
"Mom, mom, I want to tell you,
today I played with the little tiger!"
The goat mother was startled,
and after a long pause, she said:
"What, what,
you played with the little tiger?
Child, child,
today you were so dangerous!
Almost, almost,
you became his snack!
Tomorrow, tomorrow,
if he comes to play with you again,
Oh my, oh my,
he's definitely coming to eat you!
Don't be afraid, don't be afraid,
let mom think of a good plan."

[P14] The next day,
Little tiger walked over the hill,
But didn't see Little Goat;
Walk, walk,
Little tiger walked into the forest,
But didn't wait for Little Goat.
Little tiger found a small house,
And knocked on the door, 'Duk duk duk duk.'

[P15] "Baa, who are you?"
"Roar, I'm the little tiger!"
"Baa, what are you here for?"
"Roar, I'm here to play with the little goat!"

[P16] "Mee-mee, I know,
what your mom told you."
"Ahu, Mom said:
We're good friends!"
"Mee-mee, I know,
what bad plans you've made."
"Ahu, I'm thinking:
Let's sing and play together."
"Mee-mee, you're lying.
You'd better leave now!"
"Ahu, I'm telling the truth.
Open the door quickly!"
"Mee-mee, mee-mee,
No, no, I won't open it."
"Ahu, ahu,
If you don't open the door, I'll break in."

[P17] The little tiger is so thirsty, so thirsty,
The little tiger is so hungry, so hungry;
The little tiger sharpens its claws,
The little tiger's stomach growls,
It can't wait to swallow the little goat in one bite;
Bang, bang, bang...
The little tiger raises its tail and starts banging on the door!
Clack, clack, clack...
The little tiger is about to break the door open!

[P18] Baa, baa, baa, baa,
Five big goats come from the east;
Baa, baa, baa, baa,
Five big goats come from the west.
One goat, one pair of horns,
Ten goats, ten pairs of horns,
The curved horns like sickles,
Charging at the little tiger, bumping and jostling.

[P21] Baa-hee-hee, baa-hee-hee,
You little thief!
Baa-hee-hee, baa-hee-hee,
Where do you think you're running?

One goat stepped on it,
two goats bit it,
three goats head-butted it,
four goats hooked it with their horns,
hook, hook,
throwing the little tiger high into the air.

In the little tiger's mouth,
three teeth fell out;
on the little tiger's feet,
four claws were injured;
by the little tiger's ear,
a patch of fur was lost;
on the little tiger's head,
two bumps appeared.

[P22] The little tiger rolled on the grass,
howling in pain, 'Ah-woo, ah-woo';
The little goat peeked through the door crack,
laughing happily, 'Baa, baa, baa, baa'.

[P25] Caterpillar Children's Library · Volume 1

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 画面中央是橙色竖幅，上书“小羊和老虎”，两侧分别绘有一只老虎和一只小羊，背景为绿色树林，底部有蘑菇和出版社名称。
[P2] 页面底部绘有绿色的树木和灌木丛，点缀着黄色小花，背景为白色，右侧有淡蓝色云朵状图案，整体呈现森林边缘的自然景象。
[P3] 画面中，一只戴着花环、抱着花束的小羊在草地上奔跑，上方有一只张着嘴的老虎和两只蝴蝶，背景是绿色的灌木丛和白色天空。
[P4] 本页展示了插画家杨永青的肖像及其生平简介，介绍了他的艺术专长、工作经历、创作数量和所获荣誉。
[P5] 本页为绘本《小山羊和小老虎》的标题页，显示了书名、作者鲁兵和插画师杨永青的署名，以及连环画出版社的名称。画面左侧有一只戴着花环、抱着花束的小羊正从门后探出头来。
[P6] 本页介绍了故事中的两个主角：一只毛色雪白、叫声‘咩咩’的小山羊，和一只尾巴粗壮、叫声‘啊呜’的小老虎，画面分别描绘了它们活泼可爱的形象。
[P7] 前一天，小山羊起得很早，唱着歌儿到树林里吃草，画面中它戴着花环，手持花朵，旁边有一只老虎在树后窥视。
[P8] 本页描述小老虎一早吃完饭后，到树林里玩耍打虎跳，画面中它张着嘴跳跃，周围有落叶和蘑菇。
[P9] 小山羊和小老虎在树林里相遇，一个唱歌，一个跳虎跳，他们一起玩捉迷藏和赛跑。
[P10] 太阳下山后，小老虎回到家，向妈妈报告自己和小山羊一起玩耍的事情。
[P12] 小老虎向妈妈抱怨小山羊，妈妈教导它要假装友好，用谎言引诱小山羊靠近后再抓住它。
[P13] 小山羊回家后告诉妈妈自己和小老虎玩耍了，山羊妈妈非常惊慌，担心小老虎会吃掉小山羊，并决定想办法应对。
[P14] 第二天，小老虎在山岗和树林里寻找小山羊未果，随后找到一间小屋子，用力敲门。
[P15] 小老虎来到一扇门前敲门，与门内的人对话，声称自己来找小山羊玩耍。
[P16] 小老虎来到小山羊家门前敲门，声称想和小山羊一起玩耍，但小山羊识破其谎言，拒绝开门，小老虎威胁要闯入。
[P17] 小老虎因饥饿和口渴，急于抓住小山羊，用尾巴猛烈撞击小山羊家的门，试图闯入。
[P18] 画面中，十只大山羊从东西两边赶来，它们的羊角弯曲如镰刀，正朝着小老虎冲撞过去，形成对峙场面。
[P19] 画面中，一只小老虎张牙舞爪地面对从左右两侧冲来的十只大山羊，山羊们羊角弯曲如镰刀，形成对峙场面，背景有绿色灌木。
[P20] 画面中，多只大山羊从左右两侧冲向小老虎，羊角弯曲如镰刀，形成对峙场面，背景有绿色灌木。
[P21] 十只大山羊合力攻击小老虎，用脚踩、嘴咬、头撞、角挑等方式将其击飞，小老虎受伤严重，掉了牙齿、伤了爪子、耳朵少毛、头顶起包。
[P22] 小老虎被大山羊们击败后，在草地上痛苦地打滚，而小山羊则从门缝里看着，开心地笑着。
[P23] 画面底部有绿色灌木和黄色小花，背景为白色，无可见文字。
[P24] 画面中，小老虎被击败后在空中翻滚，表情痛苦；小山羊戴着花环、抱着花束欢快地跳跃，背景有蝴蝶和绿色灌木。
[P25] 本页展示了《毛毛虫童书馆》系列丛书的目录，分为三辑，列出了各辑包含的绘本名称，其中第三辑的《小山羊和小老虎》被标记为当前故事。页面下方有一只戴着花环、手持花朵的小山羊插图，表现其欢快的状态。
